officialAerodromeReferencePoint.finding: The official ENKJ aerodrome reference point is effectively identical to the rounded canonical coordinate.

currentOperationalCrossCheck.finding: ENKJ Kjeller airport is listed with Kjeller Aero Senter AS as operator.

airportOperatorData.finding: The operator identifies ENKJ at 59°58.2′N, 011°02.3′E and publishes runway 12/30 as 1,357 by 30 metres.

heritageContext.finding: Riksantikvaren describes Kjeller as a valuable aviation, technology, defence and security-policy culture environment dating from 1912. The published case page is marked concluded, so it is used as historical and scope context rather than proof of a current final protection decision.

independentEntityCrossCheck.finding: The independent airport entity is close to the official ARP but is not used ahead of the current Avinor AIP reference point.

radiusDecision.finding: The radius is retained as a central gameplay and display area around the official ARP. It cannot and does not represent the full runway or airfield perimeter.

decision.representationLimit: The marker is the official ENKJ aerodrome reference point. The 360-metre circle is not the runway, operational movement area, airport boundary, safety zone, planned development area or heritage-protection polygon.
